decided_by: Malcolm picked PDG-1-helices-both-edges-nbp_pro_01 from the graphite-register batch
note:
Header banner for /pages/pdrn-research. Replaces skingenetix-philosophy-research.jpg — an open journal and amber vials lifted off the philosophy page, which is neither this molecule nor this palette.

SOURCE: wave `page-pdrn-research-graphite`, concept PDG-1, Nano Banana Pro candidate 01. Class B — no product in frame, no brand identity supplied.

CROPPED, NOT EXTENDED. Nano Banana returns 6336x2688 (2.357:1) whatever size it is asked for, and the band measures 1920x454 live, needing 4.229:1. The Matrixyl research header solved the same problem the same way — take the surplus off, invent nothing. Here 1190px comes off, leaving 6336x1498 at 4.230:1.

THE CROP OFFSET WAS MEASURED, NOT CENTRED. Nine candidate bands were scored on two things: bright helices at the edges, dark ground in the middle where the centred heading sits. A top-anchored crop scored best on edge/centre separation (+78.8) but put a blown highlight directly behind the heading — the text zone measured max 242. At top=444 that zone reads mean 30.0, max 76, and the helices at both edges survive intact. Separation is not the whole story; what sits behind the type is.

MALCOLM CHOSE THIS FRAME OVER MY RECOMMENDATION, and my reservation is recorded rather than hidden: at mean luminance 74.8 it is far brighter than the Matrixyl header it was asked to resemble (40.0), so the two research pages will not read as a matched pair. That reservation applies to the frame overall. It does not apply to legibility — the centre, which is what the heading sits on, measures 30.7.

OVERLAY 50 -> 25, matching the sibling research pages (Matrixyl 25, Copper Peptide 22). At 50 this shot goes flat and grey.

MOBILE: the desktop frame is 4.23:1 and the phone band is 1.048:1, so cover would have shown only the empty dark centre — a blank rectangle. The phone gets its own crop instead, taken across the LEFT bank of helices so it has a subject at all, with a scrim baked into the bottom of the file for the centred text. Bottom 26% reads mean 23.7, max 90, against 44.5 / 188 before.

OPTIMISATION, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED: desktop capped at 3000 on the long edge — the widest the theme's srcset requests for a full-bleed banner — quality 95, 4:4:4, metadata stripped, and deliberately not compressed harder, because Shopify's CDN re-encodes to WebP and a pre-compressed source hands it artefacts to reproduce.

images.alt: Banks of DNA double helices lit in blush pink at either side of a dark graphite field, representing the salmon-derived polynucleotides (INCI Sodium DNA) in PDRN
